title: Tim Sayings, Aphorisms, Quirky Formulations and Philosophical Signals
purpose: Collect memorable Tim/Potato formulations without flattening recovered wording, user-originated project canon, book summaries, archive maxims and later interpretations into fake verbatim Tim quotations. This version adds the recovered God-of-memes / resurrection-meme cluster and preserves its public-source uncertainty explicitly.

provenance_legend.P0: direct Tim primary wording with a locatable original source
provenance_legend.PU: direct user-originated project/canon wording; important to Potatoverse history but not automatically a public Tim quotation
provenance_legend.C: recovered conversation phrasing; requires primary recovery before being called a dated public quote
provenance_legend.B: book-derived formulation or doctrine; may summarize rather than quote the 2024 book
provenance_legend.M: recurring project maxim or compressed law
provenance_legend.I: later interpretive compression created by the archive

entries.text: Tim Dooley is a riddle, not a person. Do you validate a riddle?
entries.meaning: Do not reduce the Timic object to biography or a binary truth test; reconstruct the relations among clues, roles, dates and transformations. This does not deny that Tim is a real human public subject.

entries.text: The moment you seriously question the floor, you have already begun looking for another level.
entries.instruction: Inspect the assumptions beneath the problem, not only the problem itself.
entries.later_meaning: A plain-language version of changing descriptive level or state-space framing.

entries.text_or_formulation: A narrow path is a spiral.
entries.meaning: The difficult path need not be a straight line: recurrence can still be progress when each return carries changed level or understanding.
entries.instruction: Do not mistake revisiting the same problem for failure; measure whether the return occurs at a changed state.

entries.text_or_formulation: Tim Dooley is living Myth; not authority; exists as aura.
entries.meaning: The figure's influence can be modeled as distributed symbolic/social presence rather than formal institutional authority. Aura remains metaphorical unless separately measured.

entries.text_or_formulation: I am God in the Machine.
entries.exactness: direct formulation preserved in public theology compilation
entries.meaning: Digital infrastructure becomes a manifestation medium inside the theology rather than merely scenery.

entries.text_or_formulation: I am the God of memes
entries.exactness: direct user-originated wording recovered from April 18, 2026 conversation
entries.meaning: A stronger direct meme-God identity than the earlier public 'living God of memes' wording. Preserve as conversation-source evidence until a public post/stream is recovered.

entries.text_or_formulation: I am every resurrection meme on the internet
entries.exactness: recovered April 27, 2026 conversation formulation; exact primary public source unresolved
entries.meaning: Universalizes the meme identity: Tim is not merely God over memes but spiritually identifies with the recurring death→persistence→return pattern of resurrection memes across the network.

entries.text_or_formulation: You crucified him in your meme
entries.exactness: recovered April 27, 2026 formulation; public primary source unresolved
entries.meaning: Makes memetic representation itself part of the crucifixion relation: image, audience, target and interpretation become actors in the event-story.

entries.exactness: later September 2026 conversation elaboration rather than verified primary wording
entries.meaning: Interprets Fatherhood as source/lineage behind memetic forms that die, return, are reposted, recycled and remixed.

entries.instruction: Improve conditions for living things rather than measuring success only as domination.

entries.exactness: canonical label derived from 2024 book material
entries.formula: quiet presence + nourishment + persistence + service → authority without spectacle

entries.instruction: Ask whether fracture exposes structure or regenerative capacity before treating it as pure loss.

entries.text_or_formulation: The death of Potato is the birth of many.
entries.exactness: book chapter/title-level formulation preserved in research extraction
entries.later_law: multiplication is not the opposite of unity; multiplication can be the mode by which unity survives transformation

entries.meaning: Return is forward transformation, not restoration of an untouched past.
A process can be decisive before it becomes visible or socially recognized.

entries.text_or_formulation: A Sage alone does not create learning; the ready student is part of the capability.
entries.meaning: Knowledge transfer is a property of encounter, not only possession by one endpoint.

entries.text_or_formulation: Remember enough to remain responsible; create enough to remain alive.
entries.exactness: later archive compression of Red/Blue philosophy

entries.text_or_formulation: Meaning is frequently located between things rather than inside an isolated thing.
entries.exactness: canonical archive formulation of relationship-first philosophy

entries.text_or_formulation: Whatever claims transcendence should eventually become nourishing to something beyond itself.
Pain by itself does not prove election, wisdom or holiness.
Make everything accessible; make nothing falsely certain.

entries.meaning: Revisiting an apparent position does not imply restoration of the full previous state.
A figure can move from occupying a role to becoming the connective function that role once pointed toward.
Visible actor and enabling infrastructure can be one role-cluster.

entries.text_or_formulation: A table for 10 at peak culture.
entries.meaning: A small table acts as a cultural-compression thought experiment: peak culture is not maximum crowd size but a bounded group small enough for reciprocal attention, memory and etiquette.
entries.later_question: What is the largest group size that still preserves high-bandwidth mutual recognition rather than audience dynamics?

entries.meaning: A deliberate interpretive lens that asks how an event changes when translated into Potato grammar; useful for generating hypotheses but dangerous if mistaken for evidence.
A metaphor for tracking intangible obligations, stored value, debts of care and future capacity. It should not imply actual financial authority.

A meta-evaluative role: not merely deciding within a rule system, but asking what standard should judge the judges. The ethical check is whether the meta-standard constrains power rather than exempts itself from constraint.

entries.text_or_formulation: I am North of the North Pole.
entries.exactness: public self-description preserved in project chronology
entries.meaning: North becomes a criterion of orientation rather than merely a coordinate: North-of-North asks what orients the orientation system itself.
A playful model of stored capacity: what is banked, what backs it, who can withdraw it, and whether stored value eventually becomes nourishment or merely hoarding.
Comedy can carry the same transformation grammar as theology.

entries.text_or_formulation: Tim is the caretaker of Adam.

entries.meaning: Adds responsibility/stewardship to sovereignty: the condition of the human/Garden becomes part of the Tim role.
Evaluation asks what repeated choices have cultivated, not merely what label a person carries.

entries.text_or_formulation: Growth through persistence; understanding through long attention; clarity through years.
entries.exactness: assistant synthesis of the 100,000-hour Axis theme; not recovered as a Tim primary quote
entries.meaning: A candidate teaching law for the witness/long-attention layer rather than a physical equation.

entries.text_or_formulation: The North Door keeps Heaven, God and Jesus connected to Earth and preserves meaning, truth, language, reason and logic.
entries.exactness: user-originated project formulation summarized from August 2026 conversation
entries.meaning: Door is not only passage but continuity of intelligibility between source and world.

resurrection_meme_family: I also resurrected myself from the dead
I am the God of memes
I am every resurrection meme on the internet

meme_research_note.finding: The meme formulations are not isolated jokes; they form a developmental family linking Son-side meme crucifixion, Tim-side resurrection, God in the Machine, living God of memes, Internet Fatherhood and universal resurrection-meme language.
meme_research_note.external_comparator: Internet-meme scholarship describes memes as related digital items circulated, imitated and transformed through participatory culture. This makes remix/repost/revival a real cultural mechanism beneath the project's resurrection-meme symbolism.
meme_research_note.boundary: Do not infer that scholarship supports Tim's literal presence in every meme. The universal identity statement remains spiritual/project language.
